description: This file defines the ProfilerNodeVisitor class in the Twig templating engine, specifically within the namespace for profiling nodes during template rendering. It implements methods to insert profiling nodes around template, block, and macro nodes to enable performance profiling.

classes.name:
Twig\Profiler
odeVisitor\ProfilerNodeVisitor
classes.description: Implements a node visitor that adds profiling nodes to Twig templates during rendering for performance measurement.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ProfilerNodeVisitor with an extension name and sets up the internal variable name for profiling.

methods.name: enterNode
methods.description: Returns the node unmodified; part of the NodeVisitorInterface.

methods.name: leaveNode
methods.description: Wraps template, block, and macro nodes with profiling start and end nodes to enable profiling.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority of this node visitor, which is 0.
